units.source_text: 從那以後，我每天都生活在不安與恐懼之中。

en.t: From then on, I lived every day in anxiety and fear.

units.source_text: 表面上，儘管我依然扮演著可悲的滑稽角色來博取眾人一笑，有時卻情不自禁地發出深沉的嘆息。

en.t: On the surface, although I still played the pitiful clown to make everyone laugh, at times I could not help letting out a deep, heavy sigh.

units.source_text: 一想到我不論做什麼，都會被竹一識破，而且他肯定會把這一祕密說給其他人，

en.t: Whenever I thought that no matter what I did, Takeichi would see through it, and that he would surely tell this secret to others,

units.source_text: 我的額頭就會直冒冷汗，像瘋子一樣用怪異的眼神打量四周。

en.t: cold sweat would break out on my forehead, and I would look around with strange eyes like a madman.

units.source_text: 若有可能的話，我真想一天到晚二十四小時寸步不離地監視竹一，以防從他的口中走漏這個祕密。

en.t: If it were possible, I truly wanted to watch Takeichi every hour of the day and night without leaving his side, to keep this secret from slipping out of his mouth.
